messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — after the launch we have a small backlog: 2 crash reports from Acme, a streaming latency regression, and ~8 UX polish asks. want to align on what goes into a patch vs next iteration. :hourglass: 
Alex (Eng): +1. suggest rules: safety/crash = immediate patch, high-traffic incorrectness = patch if repro rate >1% of requests, everything else bundle into next micro-sprint.
Priya (Support): Acme says crashes hit their nightly job, ~30% of their runs fail. they prefer a patch. ticket #ACME-204 attached.
Diego (SRE): we saw the streaming latency spike on 3 hosts after the model swap; CPU was fine but queue grew. could be batching change. we can put a short-term throttle in router as a mitigation while eng digs deeper.
Nora (Design): UX asks are mostly wording/spacing for the onboarding flow. none are blocking but help conversion. ok to schedule in next wave unless we can do 1-2 quick fixes.
Alex (Eng): can reproduce the crash locally with the attached trace. it's a rare edge-case in KV cache evict codepath. fix should be small but needs an injected repro and a canary rollout. estimate 1.5 dev-days + 0.5 for canary.
Maya (PM): sounds like crash -> patch. Diego, can you do a router throttle rule as a short-term shield? how long to rollout?
Diego (SRE): I can deploy a temporary rate cap in the next 2 hours, rollbackable. will post the deploy link. :wrench:
rollout-bot: Deploy queued by Diego to prod-routing (canary=10%) — https://deploys.internal/xyz-231 
Priya (Support): Acme ok with canary as long as we notify them. they want a post-fix verification plan.
Nora (Design): if we do a small copy tweak in the onboarding (10–15m), I can submit a PR today to shave friction while engineering works on the patch.
Alex (Eng): plan: 1) throttle (Diego) now, 2) crash fix branch and unit tests today, 3) canary tomorrow at 10% then 100% if green. will open a short lived feature flag for quick rollback.
Maya (PM): decision: crash = P0 patch. streaming latency = mitigation now + investigate as P1 (next micro-sprint if root cause non-trivial). UX polish = P2 next iteration. I'll update the roadmap slice and notify Acme and AE.
Priya (Support): will send Acme the canary schedule and verification checklist (smoke tests + daily job run).
Diego (SRE): throttle deployed to canary, monitoring dashboard pinned -> https://dashboards.internal/streams-latency (alerts scoped to canary).
Alex (Eng): opened PR #5123 with fix + tests. requesting review from @Diego and @Nora for rollout notes.
Maya (PM): thanks all. follow-ups: Alex to merge + canary, Diego to watch, Priya to update customer, Nora to land quick copy if time. we'll reconvene tomorrow 10:30 for canary status. :calendar:
